record.reference: Marine Harvest completed its 10-for-1 reverse split of Norwegian ordinary shares before launching the U.S. program on 2014-01-28, and each new U.S. ADS already represented one post-consolidation ordinary share. The live MHGVY tape remains in one price and volume domain across 2014-05-01, so the later 0.1 ACTIONS row is duplicate local-share treatment and the U.S.-traded ADS multiplier is 1.0.
